messages.subject: re: Parallel Growth Curve Model
parts:
Something like this?

#Latent
# I think that you meant to fix the loadings to 1 for intercepts.
ix =~ 1*x1 + 1*x2 +1*x3
sx =~ 1*x1 + 2*x2 + 3*x3
iz =~ 1*z1 + 1*z2 +1*z3
sz =~ 1*z1 + 2*z2 + 3*z3

#Regression
ix ~ age + education
sx ~ age + education
iz ~ age + education
sz ~ age + education

#Covariance
# I think that you meant to use the double-tilde operator.
# Because of the regressions, these are correlated residuals, not
simply covariances.
# So, these parameters reflect association controlling for age and
education.
# To see the simple bivariate covariance, request the latent variable
covariance matrix using lavInspect().
ix ~~ sx
iz ~~ sz
ix ~~ iz
sx ~~ sz

Keith
